nextAction: Review status/diffs and report verification evidence plus remaining direct-to-disk follow-up.
decisions: Implement resumability foundation first: authoritative server chunk ledger and resume-state query.
Use relay spool replay for receiver resend before falling back to sender-side resend.
Full browser direct-to-disk remains a separate UI/storage slice.
risks: Server chunk spool can increase disk usage and needs quota/TTL cleanup beyond session timeout cleanup.
Client reconnect currently clears local transfer sessions, so page-refresh or full reconnect UX recovery still needs File System Access/OPFS state persistence.
